rootCauseAnalysis.failurePoint: Product agent was creating duplicate tasks for UCs that already had completed tasks
rootCauseAnalysis.why: buildRoleContext() product spawnRole had no dedup check instruction; SOUL.md is only loaded for expensive models / complex tasks (score >= 3), so light tasks never saw the rule
rootCauseAnalysis.fix: Added DEDUP CHECK section to product default spawnRole in genome/core/food/role-context.js — always injected regardless of model tier. SOUL.md already had the rule from a prior edit.

taskSpec.what: genome/core/food/role-context.js buildRoleContext() product default spawnRole — add DEDUP CHECK block; workspace-product-manager/SOUL.md already had the change
taskSpec.verify: grep -n DEDUP ~/projects/genome/core/food/role-context.js → shows new section; SOUL.md lines 75-91
taskSpec.boundaries: Only product default spawnRole modified. escalation-diagnosis and product-review variants untouched. No leadflow product code changed.
